Upstream drift watch. Pins list every upstream file whose logic the Workbench mirrors: repo, path, commit, sha256 of the file at that commit, workbench_module(s) that cite it, contract (the citing line), optionally cited_lines (line range -> sha256 of those lines joined by \n, UTF-8) so a test checks a cited range without the checkout. Status 'unresolved' = commit or path was absent from the local checkout when seeded; such pins are listed, never compared, never guessed.
Check:  python3 scripts/check_upstream_drift.py  [--checkout REPO=PATH ...] [--json] [--max-files N]
Checkouts: --checkout REPO=PATH, else env PLX_DRIFT_CHECKOUT_<REPO> (upper-case, non-alphanumerics -> _), else repos.<REPO>.default_checkout (/home/user/<REPO>). Local git reads only, no network.
Exit: 0 no drift; 1 drift (changed or deleted upstream file); 2 checkout missing (its pins skipped and listed, no drift elsewhere).
Seeding: citations 'path@commit' in code, tests and verify docs. Citations in a shallow clone resolve only while the commit is within the clone's history.
Adopting an upstream change: read the new upstream code, update the mirroring module and its contract, then re-pin that entry (commit = new commit, sha256 = `git show <commit>:<path> | sha256sum`). Never re-pin without reading the change.
repo_pins: one commit per repo; ontology/source_registry.json is generated at them (`python3 -m scripts.source_registry generate`), and its `--check` fails after a repo pin moves until it is regenerated.
